pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation by splicing the dried kelp (Chaetomorpha antennina) into small sizes of less than 2 cm.

Microwave pretreatment (MP) using a microwave oven (900 W and 2450 MHz) in polytetra fluoro ethylene sealed containers with a substrate to water ratio of 1:50, with power ranging from 90 W to 720 W and treatment times from 1 to 60 min.
Chemical pretreatment using the anionic surfactant Sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate (SDBS) at concentrations ranging from 0.005 to 0.5 g/g TS.
